nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Spring POSTs {reelId, url, callbackUrl, callbackToken}. Responds 202 immediately; the result goes to callbackUrl.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Job fields + non-secret config from env. API keys are never copied into items (only booleans), so they don't end up in execution logs.

nodes.name: Transcribe (yt-dlp + Whisper)
nodes.notes: Media worker: downloads the reel with yt-dlp and transcribes it with faster-whisper. Returns {ok:false, error:{code,message}} for private reels, music-only audio, etc.

nodes.name: Detect Ollama
nodes.notes: Is a local Ollama up, and is the configured model pulled? Failure here is fine: we fall back to cloud keys, then to a heuristic.

nodes.name: Call LLM
nodes.notes: Ollama /api/chat, Anthropic /v1/messages or OpenAI /v1/chat/completions depending on what Build LLM request picked.

nodes.name: Callback to Spring
nodes.notes: POST /api/reels/{id}/ingested with the one-time X-Ingest-Token Spring minted for this job.
